svg.desc: TERRAIN CONTOURS, WIDE CUT (2026-08-21). True iso-lines of a smooth height field extracted by marching squares, so contours nest and never cross. Replaces the dense original: 10 levels instead of forty-odd, a far lower-frequency field, a tilt term so levels stay spread rather than crowding on a plateau, and a 2.2 stroke. Large, minimal, modern. Warm ink (#7A6746, the desert-taupe token) baked.
